mapper.select: SELECT event_id,event_type,trace_id,created_at,session_sequence,source_event_id FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND root_input_id=#{rootInputId} ORDER BY created_at ASC,session_sequence ASC

SELECT id,tenant_id,session_id,runtime_run_id,event_id,input_id,root_input_id,trace_id,source_event_id, caused_by_event_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload,created_at,updated_at FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=ANY(#{eventIds,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT session_sequence FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND event_id=#{eventId}

WITH snapshots AS ( SELECT id,tenant_id,session_id,runtime_run_id,event_id,input_id,root_input_id,trace_id,source_event_id, caused_by_event_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload,created_at,updated_at, min(session_sequence) OVER (PARTITION BY payload #>> '{data,message_id}') AS first_sequence, min(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY payload #>> '{data,message_id}') AS first_created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payload #>> '{data,message_id}' ORDER BY COALESCE(payload #>> '{data,message_version}', '1')::numeric DESC, session_sequence DESC) AS snapshot_rank FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND event_type IN ('message.delta','message.card','message.card.update') AND payload #>> '{data,message_id}' IS NOT NULL ) SELECT id,tenant_id,session_id,runtime_run_id,event_id,input_id,root_input_id,trace_id,source_event_id, caused_by_event_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload,created_at,updated_at, first_sequence AS first_message_sequence,first_created_at AS first_message_created_at FROM snapshots WHERE snapshot_rank=1 ORDER BY first_sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH snapshots AS ( SELECT id,tenant_id,session_id,runtime_run_id,event_id,input_id,root_input_id,trace_id,source_event_id, caused_by_event_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload,created_at,updated_at, min(session_sequence) OVER () AS first_sequence, min(created_at) OVER () AS first_created_at, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(payload #>> '{data,message_version}', '1')::numeric DESC, session_sequence ASC) AS snapshot_rank FROM nw_chat_session_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND event_type IN ('message.delta','message.card','message.card.update') AND payload #>> '{data,message_id}'=#{messageId} ) SELECT id,tenant_id,session_id,runtime_run_id,event_id,input_id,root_input_id,trace_id,source_event_id, caused_by_event_id,session_sequence,event_type,payload,created_at,updated_at, first_sequence AS first_message_sequence,first_created_at AS first_message_created_at FROM snapshots WHERE snapshot_rank=1

SELECT count(DISTINCT o.id) AS outbox_total, count(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.status IN ('queued', 'publishing')) AS webhook_pending, count(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'delivered') AS webhook_delivered, count(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'unresolved') AS webhook_failed, count(d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.status NOT IN ('queued', 'publishing', 'delivered', 'unresolved')) AS webhook_unknown FROM public.nw_chat_session_outbox o LEFT JOIN public.nw_chat_session_outbox_webhook_deliveries d ON d.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND d.outbox_event_id = o.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.session_id = #{sessionId} AND o.runtime_run_id = #{runtimeRunId}
